name: Triangular Fibrocartilage Complex Injury
definition: Traumatic or degenerative injury of the triangular fibrocartilage complex, an important stabilizer of the distal radioulnar and ulnocarpal region.

typical: Pain with forearm rotation or load

investigations.principle: MRI/MR arthrography and radiographs are selected based on suspected tear and ulnar variance.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, tumor, occult injury or condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Persistent unstable tears may require arthroscopic repair/debridement.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Manibandha-Snayu phenotype may be documented descriptively.

patientEducation.summary: Traumatic or degenerative injury of the triangular fibrocartilage complex, an important stabilizer of the distal radioulnar and ulnocarpal region.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
